summary: Returnal entries added from the live guide-pack catalogue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Returnal
entries.definitive_edition: Returnal on Windows PC with ray tracing enabled and a wired DualSense for haptic feedback and adaptive triggers

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; no emulation branch.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC with ray tracing and 4K upscaling

primary.why: The PC release is the highest-fidelity route and loses no content: ray-traced reflections and shadows with strength sliders, 16:10 plus 21:9 ultrawide and 32:9 super-ultrawide support, DLSS / NIS / FSR and FSR 2 upscaling, and an unlocked frame rate with a latency / FPS / CPU-GPU overlay. A wired DualSense keeps the haptic feedback and adaptive triggers the PS5 version is known for, so the PC route is strictly additive rather than a trade.
primary.how_to_play: Play Returnal on Windows PC with ray tracing on and a wired DualSense for haptics. Record storefront/build, upscaler and ray-tracing settings, resolution/aspect, whether the Tower of Sisyphus and co-op Ascension content is included, and cycle/biome progress per run.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PC port is CPU- and storage-hungry — record CPU, RAM and SSD state alongside GPU settings, because stutter here is usually a streaming or shader-compilation issue rather than a GPU limit.
